note: The raw annotation files (boundaries, keypoint verification, quality scores, comments) sit behind a signed license, so example 1 is the README's own verbatim example of each file (with its // comments and '...' elisions; frame numbers at 30 fps converted to seconds in the timeline). Example 2 is real public data from the code repo: the cross-view sequence-verification pair list for record ThEnUZ, whose columns are frame folder, sequence id (action-order code), start frame and end frame for each of two views, plus the label bank that maps the code to the exercise order. No clip: raw videos are not released.
